where_to_look: Whole cortical ribbon. Axial 80 is dorsal, 110 is the lateral surface, 140 is ventral temporal. Medial wall is not cortex.
Whole cortical ribbon. Coronal 80 is posterior, 120 is central, 170 is frontal.
Left lateral cortex. High sagittal index is left. 127 is midline.
Right lateral cortex. Low sagittal index is right.
Anterior-lateral ribbon on a high slice. Toward the top of the axial image (anterior).
Lateral frontal ribbon. Coronal 170 still shows the eyes.
Lateral frontal ribbon, slightly more anterior on the right in this sample.
Lateral frontal ribbon above the Sylvian fissure, in the anterior half. Face points to the right of the sagittal image.
Same landmark on the right hemisphere.
Lateral temporal gyrus. Axial 110-120 cuts across it.
Lateral temporal gyrus. Right median peak is 115, so 110 and 120 both matter.
Long anterior-posterior gyrus. Bulk is near 130; it is still on the plane from 80 through 150.
Lateral surface below the Sylvian fissure.
Most lateral left slices that still contain brain.
Most lateral right slices that still contain brain.

Anterior temporal tip, just behind the orbits.
